findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM)
findings.comment:
Observed certified food protection manager certification of PIC to be expired. PIC has taken class, but still needs to take test. 

2-102.12: (A) The PERSON IN CHARGE shall be a certified FOOD protection manager who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an ACCREDITED PROGRAM.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.citation_text: 4-602.13  (C) Soil residue present on side of refrigeration. Clean all non-food contact surfaces frequently to prevent soil accumulation.  Reference 4-602.13. Clean and maintain clean.

findings.title: Food protection during storage, prepartion, display, service, transportation
findings.comment: Personal food including shell eggs and sausage gravy are observed to be stored in the cooler which also holds food for the children. Provide barrier for personal food. Call with questions please. 750-120 At all times food shall be protected from potential contamination.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment: Shelves of lazy Susan area of cabinet are soiled. Clean and maintain free of accumulated soil. 750-800e Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

findings.title: Storage/handling of clean equipment, utensils
findings.comment: Observed the utensil holders with spoons in the cabinet drawer to be soiled with dust and crumbs. Clean and maintain free of accumulated soil. 750-860 Cleaned and sanitized utensils an equipment shall be stored at least six inches above the floor in a clean, dry location in a way that protects them from contamination by splash, dust and other means.

findings.title: Cold food at proper temperatures during storage, display, service, transport, and cold holding
findings.comment: Observed two milk gallons to be open and in use with no date of open on the containers. Properly date milk and use or discard in 7 days. Milk was labeled. 750-151(a) Refrigerated potentially hazardous ready to eat food held at the establishment more than 24 hours shall be clearly marked with the date or day by which the food shall be consumed, sold, or discarded. Maximum holding time at 41°F is 7 days. Properly date mark food and do not hold longer than 7 days.

findings.title: Storage/handling of clean equipment, utensils
findings.comment: Observed clean utensils stored in a crock on the counter which is soiled with dust in the bottom. 750-860 Cleaned and sanitized utensils an equipment shall be stored at least six inches above the floor in a clean, dry location in a way that protects them from contamination by splash, dust and other means. Clean the ustensils and crock and maintain free of accumulated soil.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment:
750.800b - Inside the kitchen microwave was soiled with dried food splash. 

To prevent cross contamination and eliminate buildup of debris, clean and sanitize in microwaves between uses/as needed (Up to every 4hrs after continuous use).

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
750.800e - The canned good storage cabinets in the upstairs kitchen and downstairs kitchenette were both observed with buildup of dust/general debris.

Clean inside the aforementioned cabinets, and all other storage areas, as needed to eliminate buildup of dust/debris.

findings.title: Storage/handling of clean equipment, utensils
findings.citation_text:
750.850 - Utensils drying in dish rack after ware washing process were observed with food surfaces extended up out of the holder. Discussed washing hands and wearing single use gloves to remove utensils from the holder once dry. Utensils should be placed in the container with handles extended up or placed within the dish rack in a way that will allow for utensils to all face one direction so only handles are touched when being retrieved after drying process is complete.

Cleaned and sanitized utensils shall be stored and handled in a way that protects them from contamination.  Spoons, knives and forks shall be touched only by their handles.

findings.title: Restrooms with self-closing doors, fixtures operate properly, facility clean, supplied with hand soa...
findings.citation_text:
750.1120 - Paper towels were not available at the handsink. Paper towels were taken to the classroom and were returned to the kitchen.

Maintain a supply of paper towels and soap at the handsink at all times to allow for proper handwashing.
